title: 第43章 何彩云鱼塘第44章 不拿我当外人
content_zh:
“温柔点，赵大爷……”陈慧兰娇羞道。
“怎么又叫我赵大爷了，这种时候你应该叫我老公，叫我好哥哥也行。”赵富贵坏笑起来。
“老公……”
陈慧兰含羞带怯的叫了一声，那醉人的声音顿时就令赵富贵全身骨头酥软。
赵富贵的心儿都颤抖起来了。
次日早上，赵富贵才刚刚吃完早饭，一个女人就来到他家里了——正是结果三次婚也离过三次婚的何彩云！
何彩云似乎有什么事情找赵富贵帮忙，所以进了院子以后就表现的有点束手束脚，两只手捏着衣角给人一种无处安放的感觉。
“瘸……赵大爷？赵大爷你在家吗？”何彩云喊道。
赵富贵从屋子里出来，疑惑的问道：“彩云妹子你来我家干甚？”
“我想请你帮个忙。”何彩云说道。
“你怎么了？出啥事了？”赵富贵疑惑的问道。
“你不是懂医术嘛，那你去我家鱼塘，给我鱼塘里的鱼检查检查。也不知道怎么的，我鱼塘里的鱼就好像生病了似的，都不怎么吃鱼食了。”何彩云说道。
赵富贵感到又好笑又好气：“我现在确实懂医术，但是给鱼治病那是兽医的事儿，你去县城兽医站找兽医去。”
“找兽医不得花钱嘛。”何彩云不大好意思的说道。
“找我就不用花钱了？”赵富贵没好气的说道。
何彩云脸颊上浮现起一片红霞，似乎有些害臊，但她的腮帮子也鼓起来了，好像还有点生气。
“你帮不帮我？”何彩云问道。
“不帮，你能咋滴？”赵富贵说道。
“那天在后山上，你还对我动手动脚的哩，甚至还想把我……把我那个了！”何彩云气鼓鼓的说道。
“可我也没占到啥便宜啊，我又没把你怎么样。”赵富贵说道。

“不管你有没有把我怎么样，你对我动手动脚这是事实，你现在要是不帮我，我就……我就找陈慧兰，我把你在后山上欺负我的事儿全告诉她！”
何彩云话音一落就要离开，似乎真的打算去隔壁找陈慧兰。
赵富贵顿时急眼了，赶忙追了过去抓住何彩云的纤纤玉手：“彩云妹子你这就太那啥了，我刚刚跟你开玩笑哩，你说你这么激动干啥子。”
“你那是开玩笑吗？”何彩云气呼呼的说道。
“我就是在开玩笑，我真的在和你开玩笑，彩云妹子你亲自过来找我帮忙，我怎么会不帮呢！”
赵富贵搓搓手就接着说道：“走走走，现在就去你家，我保证把你的鱼治好，让你的鱼都活蹦乱跳。”
“那你要是治不好咋整？”何彩云问道。
“治不好我就不收你的钱。”赵富贵想都没想就说道。
“你治好了我也不给你钱，你敢跟我要钱我就去找陈慧兰！”何彩云虎着脸说道。
“行行行，我怕了你了还不行吗？”赵富贵苦笑连连。
从家里出来以后，赵富贵就跟着何彩云朝着她家走去。
content_en:
"Be gentle, Uncle Zhao..." Chen Huilan said shyly.
"Why are you calling me Uncle Zhao again? At this time, you should call me husband. You can also call me good brother." Zhao Fugui smirked.
"Husband..."
Chen Huilan called out shyly, and the intoxicating voice immediately made all the bones in Zhao Fugui's body go soft.
Zhao Fugui's heart trembled.
The next morning, Zhao Fugui had just finished breakfast when a woman came to his house - it was He Caiyun who had been married and divorced three times!
He Caiyun seemed to have asked Zhao Fugui for help with something, so after entering the yard, he acted a little restrained. He held the corners of his clothes with both hands, giving people the feeling that he had nowhere to put himself.
"Lame...Uncle Zhao? Uncle Zhao, are you at home?" He Caiyun shouted.
Zhao Fugui came out of the house and asked doubtfully: "Sister Caiyun, why did you come to my house?"
"I want to ask you for a favor." He Caiyun said.
"What's wrong with you? What happened?" Zhao Fugui asked in confusion.
"Don't you know medical skills? Then go to my fish pond and check the fish in my pond. I don't know why, but the fish in my pond seem to be sick and don't eat much fish food." He Caiyun said.
Zhao Fugui felt funny and angry: "I do understand medical skills now, but treating fish is a veterinarian's business. You go to the county veterinary station to find a veterinarian."
"You don't have to spend money to find a veterinarian." He Caiyun said sheepishly.
"You don't have to spend money to find me?" Zhao Fugui said angrily.
A blush appeared on He Caiyun's cheeks, as if she was a little embarrassed, but her cheeks also puffed up, as if she was still a little angry.
"Can you help me?" He Caiyun asked.
"If you don't help, what can you do?" Zhao Fugui said.
"That day on the back mountain, you still touched me, and you even wanted to... kill me!" He Caiyun said angrily.
"But I didn't take any advantage, and I didn't do anything to you." Zhao Fugui said.
"No matter what you did to me or not, it is a fact that you did something to me. If you don't help me now, I will... I will find Chen Huilan, and I will tell her everything about you bullying me on the back mountain!"
He Caiyun was about to leave as soon as he finished speaking, and it seemed that he really planned to go next door to find Chen Huilan.
Zhao Fugui suddenly became anxious and hurriedly chased after He Caiyun and grabbed He Caiyun's slender hand: "Sister Caiyun, you are too much. I was joking with you just now. Why are you so excited?"
"Are you kidding me?" He Caiyun said angrily.
"I'm just joking, I'm really joking with you. Sister Caiyun, come here and ask me for help in person, how could I not help!"
Zhao Fugui rubbed his hands and continued: "Let's go, let's go to your house now. I promise to cure your fish and make your fish jump alive."
"Then what should you do if you can't cure it?" He Caiyun asked.
"I won't take your money if it can't be cured." Zhao Fugui said without thinking.
"I won't give you any money after you are cured. If you dare to ask me for money, I will go to Chen Huilan!" He Caiyun said with a tigerish face.
"Okay, okay, why don't you think I'm afraid of you?" Zhao Fugui smiled bitterly.
After coming out of home, Zhao Fugui followed He Caiyun towards her home.
